tutorial.welcome: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.mint.collect: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.build: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.keep: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.done: The Keep is ready. Well done!
tutorial.army.tower: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.all: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.train: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.raid: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.end: Well fought. Raids fill your storage fast: upgrade the Clan Keep (or a storage) next. Then upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
whatsNew.0_1_0: What's new: send your squad in with one order, watch the fight up close or faster, and see what another entry point would have done. Every raid on your village now has a report, and you can test your defenses. New: a four-week event calendar with festivals, a weekly Gauntlet, daily contracts, achievements, Keep seals and looks to earn.

codex.temperRule: From Clan Keep {level}, defenses can be tempered: Reach shoots farther but softer, Blast hits groups but fires slower, Watch strengthens air defense and traps. Each rival clan leans one way:

With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.

whatsNew.0_2_0: What's new: choose a larger text size, and turn screen shake and flashes down, in Settings. The stake picker shows how often your recent raids reached two and three stars. Shadow Trials climb more evenly, and raids at Keep 4 and Keep 15 meet fairer opponents.
strategy.title: {n, plural, one {Prebuilt strategies (#)} other {Prebuilt strategies (#)}}
strategy.intro: Each strategy fills your Squad Courtyards from the warriors you can train now. Train queues what you can pay for.
strategy.bladeRush.name: Blade Rush
strategy.bladeRush.text: Fast blades behind a guardian front line, with a healer. Strong against bases with few splash defenses.
strategy.steelRain.name: Rain of Steel
strategy.steelRain.text: Throwers strike from range while guardians draw the fire. Good against bases behind walls.
strategy.jamStrike.name: Jam and Strike
strategy.jamStrike.text: Saboteurs jam the nearest defenses first, then blades and throwers clear the base.
strategy.wallBreakers.name: Wall Breakers
strategy.wallBreakers.text: Siege crews break walls and heavy buildings while guardians and blades protect them.
strategy.tunnelStrike.name: Tunnel Strike
strategy.tunnelStrike.text: Infiltrators get past the walls and blades follow them in, with siege for what stands in the way.
strategy.skyRaid.name: Sky Raid
strategy.skyRaid.text: Flyers pass over every wall. Send them where the Sky Bow Towers are few.
strategy.beastPack.name: Beast Pack
strategy.beastPack.text: Beast handlers and their animals behind a guardian wall, kept going by a healer.
strategy.shadowAmbush.name: Shadow Ambush
strategy.shadowAmbush.text: Shadow warriors slip past the towers and strike from inside, with infiltrators and blades.
lesson.skipAsk: Skip Sensei's lessons? You can replay them from Settings.
lesson.intro: You have taken your first steps. Now a few short lessons on running a clan. Each one waits for you, so play as you read.
lesson.storage: Storage sets how much you can hold. Bigger upgrades cost more than a small Treasury holds, so upgrade the Treasury and the Provision Storehouse.
lesson.collectAll: When several collectors have something in them, any collector's sheet offers Collect all: one tap for the whole village.
lesson.artisans: Each Artisan builds or upgrades one thing at a time. The top bar shows how many are free; every Artisan's Hut adds one more.
lesson.defenses: Rival clans raid while you are away. Build more defenses around the Keep and your storages, and mix them: Firework Mortars splash groups, Sky Bow Towers hit flyers.
lesson.walls: Stone Walls make raiders walk around or break through, under fire. Spike Pits and Caltrop Fields stay hidden until warriors step close.
lesson.research: In the Army panel, the Research tab makes a warrior stronger for good. Start with the warriors you train most.
lesson.strategies: Not sure what to bring? The Train tab offers a Suggested army and Prebuilt strategies: one tap queues a whole mix, and each says what it is good against.
lesson.jade: Short of Provisions? Gold buttons buy only what is missing with Jade, for one warrior, five, ten or a full Courtyard. Every purchase asks first, and waiting always works too.
lesson.saveArmy: Found a mix you like? On the Army tab, tap Save this army. Next time, refill it with one tap.
lesson.scout: Before every raid, read the scout report: it lists the Infiltration Points and the defenses covering each path. Go in where the fewest defenses reach.
lesson.abilities: In battle, Smoke Bomb hides your warriors: inside the smoke they can only be shot from close up. Saboteurs jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike.
lesson.shield: A shield keeps raiders away for a while. Attacking ends your own shield, so look at its time before you raid.
lesson.defenseLog: The battle log shows every raid on your village, with a report. Test my defenses lets you raid your own base and find its weak spots.
lesson.daily: Come back each day for the daily chest and the 28-day calendar. A missed day never wipes your progress.
lesson.trials: Shadow Trials are an endless ladder of generated fortresses. Clear a tier to climb; after a failed attempt you can try a different fortress.
lesson.alliance: Join an Alliance: allies send warriors who fight first in your next raid, and you can chat with them.
lesson.end: That is all I can teach for now. Collect, upgrade, raid and grow your clan. You can replay these lessons from Settings.
